target_customer: Small businesses without a marketing team that want ads, email and direct mail run for them
problem: Most small businesses cannot afford a marketing team and agencies charge thousands per month for one or two channels.
business_model: Subscription (Starter $99, Pro $199, Ultimate $299 per month, credits included) plus a 10 to 20 percent fee on ad spend

founders.name: Danny Chmaytelli
education: UCLA, full ride Regents Scholarship (per YC page)
previous_startups: Bloom (grew to $3M+ ARR per YC page; appeared on Shark Tank season 17)
founders.background_notes: Z Fellow per YC page. YC lists a team of one.

competitors.name: MAI
competitors.what: AI agents that run performance marketing for small and mid-size businesses, starting with Google Ads
competitors.funding_then: Reported $25M seed led by Kleiner Perkins

competitors.name: Mega
competitors.what: AI marketing tool for small businesses
competitors.funding_then: Reported $11.5M Series A led by Goodwater

competitors.name: Blaze Autopilot
competitors.what: Agentic AI that owns small business marketing

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating ads and managing campaigns through Meta, Google and email APIs is integration heavy but uses existing models and APIs; TV and direct mail add fulfilment partners.

defensibility.rationale: Funded competitors and ad platforms offered similar automation, and the product is mostly orchestration of third party channels.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Ad platforms and Klaviyo shipped autonomous campaign agents in 2025. Later outcome unknown.

market_need_then: Small business owners lack marketing staff and agency costs are high. Several funded startups launched small business ad agents in 2025, showing investor belief in demand. Render reports 1,000+ paying businesses (YC page, self-reported).

branding.domain_note: Uses tryrender.ai with a try prefix; render.com belongs to an unrelated cloud company that raised $100M in 2026.

identity.logo: A Render wordmark, design not described by sources
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, direct, friendly and plain spoken for owners with no marketing background; Get more customers, on autopilot

brand_strength.rationale: The name is shared with a much larger cloud company and a GPU network, so searches return other firms, and no brand press about this product was found.

outcome_analysis: Render is a one person Winter 2027 company that states 1.7 million dollars of ARR and 1,000+ paying businesses on its YC page, which is self-reported and unverified. It sells into a crowded AI small business marketing field, and no funding or exit news was found, so the outcome is open.
notes: Funding searches were swamped by the unrelated Render cloud company (render.com); nothing found for tryrender.ai. ARR and customer figures come only from the YC page. Bloom details come from the YC page; the Shark Tank blog search result was not opened.
